paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the early outlook with a cautiously negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -24/100. Consolidation Risk is 17/100 (Low).
The main cross-asset drivers are Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 4.936%. Volatility is a headwind: VXN 33.34 (-13.47%) | VIX 23.81 (-11.16%). Fed pricing remains a headwind.
Nasdaq internals are mixed, so directional confirmation is incomplete (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps mixed, breadth positive).

What would change the view: improvement would require Treasury yields easing and stabilizing, semiconductors regaining leadership, VXN/VIX cooling. Deterioration would be reinforced by breadth narrowing materially.
